headline.text: A mouse study found dexamethasone lowered abiraterone exposure about ten-fold by area under the curve.

reported.text: A retrospective review of 53 patients found no significant potassium change with abiraterone plus dexamethasone or prednisolone.

claims.text: In mice given dexamethasone for three days before an abiraterone acetate dose, maximum plasma concentration fell about five-fold and area under the curve about ten-fold.
claims.quote: Our results demonstrated that dexamethasone lowered the maximum plasma concentration and area under the curve parameters by approximately five- and ten-fold, respectively.
claims.judgeRationale: Mouse PK study reports dexamethasone pretreatment lowered abiraterone Cmax about five-fold and AUC about ten-fold; claim states it is in mice.

claims.text: In a retrospective review of 53 patients taking abiraterone with prednisolone or dexamethasone, neither group showed significant changes in serum potassium after starting treatment.
claims.quote: Both groups showed no significant changes in serum potassium level before and after starting treatment.
claims.judgeRationale: Retrospective study of 53 patients on abiraterone with prednisolone or dexamethasone reports no significant serum potassium change in either group.

gaps.text: The FDA abiraterone label excerpt in the packet does not mention dexamethasone. No controlled human pharmacokinetic study was found in the PubMed search.
